name: Roasted Creole Half Chicken (Plain Roast Mod)
whyItWorks: Slow-roasted chicken breast and thigh meat is soft and easy to digest once you remove the spiced skin and skip the pecan-studded side.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Remove the spiced skin (or request the lighter-note plain roasted chicken breast) and swap the sweet potato/pecan bread pudding side for plain mashed potatoes or white rice.
watchOuts: Whole pecan nut shards in the bread pudding side
Creole spice on the chicken skin
